columns.comment: True for items raised by the latest ER run (ER-20260930).
columns.name: is_latest_run

comment: Data-steward queue of entity resolution: one row per review item raised by an ER run for a candidate record pair scoring 0.75-0.90 (below the 0.90 auto-match), with both candidate names as recorded, the score, the assigned steward, created / decided dates, the decision (Match / No Match; simulated review with a 2% error rate), status (Open / Decided), days open and an aging bucket. The item is attached to the current golden client of its left record. Use is_open_at_as_of for the open queue at 30-Sep-2026. Grain: one row per steward review item.
